learning-obj.en: Understand the management principles, skills, and roles and responsibilities of managers in organizational settings.
Learn strategies for managing change and fostering innovation and adaptability.
Explore the similarities and differences among transactional, charismatic and transformational leadership and how to inspire more follower commitment and optimism.
Develop decision-making skills using critical and analytical thinking to solve complex problems and make informed decisions.
Understand how different organizational structures influence organizational effectiveness and employee behavior.
Gain skills in managing teams, managing conflicts, and fostering a productive and inclusive workplace culture.
Understand how power is acquired, its effects on leadership, and how leaders use influence tactics.
Explore theories of motivation and their practical applications in the workplace, as well as methods for controlling and guiding organizational operations towards set goals.
Explore how leaders and followers interact, manage impressions, and influence each other.
Learn about controlling organizational performance and contemporary issues in control.

“Leadership: Theory and Practice” by Peter G. Northouse, SAGE Publications, 2018  M02 9 - 528 pages.

learning_outcome.en: Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of general management theories and practices
Apply strategic thinking and decision-making skills in complex business scenarios
Evaluate leadership styles and their impact on organizational culture and performance
Develop and lead high-performing teams in diverse business contexts

module_overview.en: This module aims to provide MBA students with a comprehensive  understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting  practices. Students will explore financial statement analysis, accounting standards, and the role of financial reporting in decision-making.

learning_outcome.en: Identify the role of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and FRS in determining financial statement content
Understand the accounting information users involved in accounting communication process
Analyze and interpret a company’s performance based on financial analysis methods
Recognize how a company’s business strategy affects financial statement analysis

learning-obj.en: Definition and scope of managerial economics
Role of managerial economics in decision-making
Application of microeconomic and macroeconomic principles
Behavioral economics and its relevance to managers
Global economic trends and their implications
Impact of economic indicators on business  decisions
Perfect competition, monopoly, oligopoly, and monopolistic competition
Pricing strategies and their economic rationale
Production functions and optimal resource allocation
Time series analysis and economic forecasting
Integrating economic insights into strategic business planning

module_overview.en: This module introduces the principles of managerial economics,  providing a foundation for understanding how economic analysis can  inform decision-making within organizations. It covers economic  theories and methodologies relevant to managerial decision-making  in a business context.

learning_outcome.en: Apply economic theories and concepts to analyze and solve  complex business problems.
Evaluate the economic environment and its impact on  business decision-making.
Assess the demand and supply dynamics in different market  structures and industries.
Analyze production costs and make informed pricing  decisions for optimal revenue generation.
Apply game theory and strategic decision-making in  competitive business scenarios.
Communicate economic insights effectively to support  managerial decision processes.

module_overview.en: This module is designed to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to utilize statistical techniques and data analytics tools for effective decision-making in business contexts. Through hands-on exercises, case studies, and practical applications, students will learn to analyze data, derive insights, and make  informed decisions to solve real-world business problems

learning_outcome.en: Apply statistical methods to analyze and interpret business data.
Utilize data visualization techniques to communicate  insights effectively.
Develop predictive models using statistical and machine  learning techniques.
Apply data analytics tools to extract meaningful information  from large datasets.
Critically evaluate the reliability and validity of data  analysis results.
Make informed decisions based on data-driven insights to  solve business problems.

module_overview.en: This module focuses on integrating sustainability principles into the strategic decision-making process of organizations. It aims to equip  students with the knowledge and skills needed to navigate the complex landscape of sustainable business practices.

learning-obj.en: Defining sustainability in a business context

Identifying key stakeholders and their interests.
Strategies for effective communication and engagement.
Sustainability reporting frameworks (e.g.,  GRI) and standards.
Case studies of successful sustainable business ventures.
Understanding global challenges and opportunities in sustainability.

module_overview.en: This module is designed to enable students to critically engage with the concepts of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and  Business Ethics within the context of contemporary business practices. Students will explore theoretical frameworks, case  studies, and practical applications to understand the ethical  responsibilities of businesses and the impact of CSR on  organizational performance and society.

learning_outcome.en: Critically evaluate the theoretical foundations of CSR and  Business Ethics
Analyze the role of CSR in organizational strategy,  governance, and stakeholder engagement
Assess the ethical dilemmas faced by businesses in various  operational contexts.
Apply ethical decision-making frameworks to real-world  business scenarios.
